title: Monster Substrate Valuation Invariant
statement:
For each substrate prime p ∈ {5, 7, 11, 13} with gcd(p, 27) = 1:
  3·v₂(|C_M(pA)|) + 3p - 2·v₃(|C_M(pA)|) = v₂(|M|) - 1 = 45
domain_characterization: The four primes {5,7,11,13} are the UNIQUE Monster prime-order conjugacy classes satisfying the invariant. The invariant = 45 strictly separates them from all other primes.

monster_anchor.connection: 45 = v₂(|M|) - 1. The Monster's own 2-adic valuation anchors all substrate centralizer arithmetic.

opens: MCCXLVI — Moonshine module interpretation of invariant 45 = v₂(|M|)-1
